_README: ReelShop metafield definitions. Create these in Shopify admin under Settings > Custom data > Products > Add definition. Use the EXACT namespace 'reelshop' and the keys below. This file is documentation for your setup only; if your theme upload tool rejects unknown root files, delete it before uploading.

definitions.name: Affiliate link (REQUIRED)
definitions.note: Your Amazon / Flipkart / Meesho referral link. Opens in a new tab with rel='nofollow sponsored noopener'. Without it the CTA button is disabled.

definitions.name: Reel video URL
definitions.note: Direct .mp4 link (upload to Shopify Content > Files, or any CDN). Optional if the product uses images only. A single file_reference to an uploaded video also works.

definitions.name: Platform
definitions.note: One of: amazon, flipkart, meesho. Falls back to the section's default platform setting.

definitions.name: Display price
definitions.note: Shown with your currency symbol. Falls back to the native product price.

definitions.name: Original price (optional)
definitions.note: Higher than price to show a strikethrough + discount % badge.

definitions.name: Currency symbol (optional)
definitions.note: e.g. ₹ — overrides the theme-editor default for this product.

definitions.name: Category
definitions.note: Used by the recommendation algorithm and the category filter chips. Falls back to product type, then first tag.

definitions.name: Extra tags (optional)
definitions.note: Used by the algorithm for finer affinity. Falls back to the product's normal tags.

definitions.name: Carousel images (optional)
definitions.note: Extra photos for the horizontal swipe carousel. Falls back to the product's normal images.

definitions.name: Rating (optional)
definitions.note: 0–5, shown as stars next to the title when 'Show ratings' is enabled.
